description: This Flutter widget defines the AlertsCenterScreen, a stateless widget that displays a list of alerts using a ListView. It references provider-based state management to obtain alert data and uses custom widgets like AlertBanner.

classes.name: AlertsCenterScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a list of alert banners in a scrollable view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying an AppBar titled 'Alerts' and a list of alert banners from the provider.
